mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate above 5.0% indicates tight monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 4.5% signals labor market tightening that accelerates wage inflation and triggers Fed policy tightening, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts below 1530 thousand units and consumer spending below 378,000 million dollars indicate broad economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases when HOUST is below 1530 and RSAFS is below 378000.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (indicated by industrial production above 115 and unemployment rate below 4.5%), overheating economy triggers profit-taking and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO exceeds 115 and UNRATE is below 4.5%, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High employment growth (PAYEMS above 137,000 thousand) supports consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 137,000 thousand.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL above 207.5) triggers expectations of Fed tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 207.5.

mechanism_narrative: Combined high federal funds rate (above 5.0%) and rising inflation (CPIAUCSL above 207.5) signals aggressive monetary policy that depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0% and CPIAUCSL exceeds 207.5, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Weak consumer spending (RSAFS below 375,000 million dollars) and declining housing starts (HOUST below 1500 thousand units) indicate deteriorating economic activity, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS is below 375,000 and HOUST is below 1500, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.
